title: MAFS v3.0-P0 QueryAST
description: Machine query AST. Precedence is encoded structurally: AND binds tighter than OR; NOT is unary. Parentheses are explicit children. Per-op structural rules (e.g., AND/OR require >=2 children, NOT requires exactly 1, PHRASE requires non-empty phrase, FIELD requires valid field tag and value) are enforced by the Python validator (mafs_p0.query_ast.from_dict); the JSON Schema deliberately does NOT use if/then because that keyword is outside the P0 self-rolled validator's supported subset.
